config.masking: primary: whole patches, all three S2 band-set tokens together (a deliberate intervention; pretraining used modality_cross_random token masking, not grouped across band sets); variant: token-level complementary pairs, 50% hidden, every token hidden TOKEN_PAIRS times
config.target: target_encoder.patch_embeddings (token_exit_cfg 0), cosine distance / centred / patch-disc NLL

prereg.combination: U+ = mean of within-scene midrank percentiles of confidence and of the primary decoder score
prereg.note: river-level one-sided exact sign tests are the inference; scene-level W/L/T are descriptive
Bolivia is one flood event; per-tile signs are descriptive, not an exact test
